question: For the user No.24, how many times is the number of his/her posts compared to his/her votes?
evidence: user no. 24 refers to UserId = OwnerUserId = '24'; times of his/her post than votes = Divide (Count(post.Id), Count(votes.Id))
clarification: Count each distinct Id only once.
gold: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT T2.Id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.Id) FROM votes AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.UserId = 24
gold0: SELECT CAST(COUNT(T2.Id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.Id) FROM votes AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.UserId = 24

c.request:
For the user No.24, how many times is the number of his/her posts compared to his/her votes?
Evidence: user no. 24 refers to UserId = OwnerUserId = '24'; times of his/her post than votes = Divide (Count(post.Id), Count(votes.Id))
Count each distinct Id only once.
c.sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT p.Id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT v.Id) FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id LEFT JOIN votes v ON v.UserId = u.Id WHERE u.Id = 24

d.request: For user No. 24 (UserId = OwnerUserId = '24'), how many times is the number of their posts compared to the number of their votes, calculated as the count of distinct post Ids divided by the count of distinct vote Ids?
d.sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT p.Id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT v.Id) FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id LEFT JOIN votes v ON v.UserId = u.Id WHERE u.Id = 24

b.request: Divide the number of distinct posts (COUNT(DISTINCT posts.Id)) owned by user 24 (OwnerUserId = 24) by the number of distinct votes (COUNT(DISTINCT votes.Id)) cast by user 24 (votes.UserId = 24), counting each Id only once
b.sql: SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Id) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = 24) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Id) FROM votes WHERE UserId = 24) AS ratio
